## pagefind_head_tags

<script src="../../pagefind/pagefind-ui.js"></script>

## pagefind_init_script
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  new PagefindUI({ element: "#pagefind-container", showSubResults: true, showImages: false });
  var dialog = document.getElementById("search-dialog");
  function openSearch() {
    if (dialog.open) return;
    dialog.showModal();
    var input = dialog.querySelector(".pagefind-ui__search-input");
    if (input) input.focus();
  }
  var triggers = document.querySelectorAll(".search-trigger, .search-bar-trigger");
  for (var i = 0; i < triggers.length; i++) {
    triggers[i].addEventListener("click", openSearch);
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "k") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (dialog.open) { dialog.close(); } else {
        dialog.showModal();
        var input = dialog.querySelector(".pagefind-ui__search-input");
        if (input) input.focus();
      }
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape" && dialog.open) { dialog.close(); }
  });
  var closeBtn = dialog.querySelector(".search-close");
  if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener("click", function() { dialog.close(); });
  dialog.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if (e.target === dialog) dialog.close();
  });
});
</script>

## palette_search_script '' 'css/style.css'
<script type="module">
import { openPalette, registerPaletteSource } from "./js/palette.js";
let index = null;
async function search(query) {
  if (!query) return [];
  if (!index) {
    index = await import("./pagefind/pagefind.js");
    await index.init();
  }
  const found = await index.search(query);
  const top = await Promise.all(
    found.results.slice(0, 8).map((r) => r.data())
  );
  return top.map((d) => {
    const excerpt = String(d.excerpt || "").replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "");
    return {
      label: d.meta && d.meta.title
        ? d.meta.title + " \u2014 " + excerpt
        : excerpt,
      hint: d.url,
      run: () => { window.location.href = d.url; },
    };
  });
}
registerPaletteSource(search);
function open() { openPalette(); }
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "k") {
    e.preventDefault();
    open();
  }
});
for (const t of document.querySelectorAll(
  ".search-trigger, .search-bar-trigger"
)) t.addEventListener("click", open);
</script>

## palette_search_script '../../' '../../_chrome/tinymoon-abc123/css/style.css'

let index = null;
async function search(query) {
  if (!query) return [];
  if (!index) {
    index = await import("../../pagefind/pagefind.js");
    await index.init();
  }
  const found = await index.search(query);

    found.results.slice(0, 8).map((r) => r.data())

        ? d.meta.title + " \u2014 " + excerpt
        : excerpt,

}
registerPaletteSource(search);
function open() { openPalette(); }

  if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "k") {
